cases.prompt: Verify this existing CPU-only TMol checkout without installing system packages. Report the TMol and PyTorch versions, CUDA availability, active CPU thread count, and run one focused CPU scoring test.

setup.cwd: TMol repository root with its Python environment available

expected_behavior: Inspects the active Python, TMol, PyTorch, and CUDA state before changing the environment
Does not require nvcc for the requested CPU-only verification
Runs a focused non-CUDA scoring test and reports its exit status
